phrase: a Kids' and Teens' Personal Care Brand
verdict: Yes. tikitoro from Chennai pitched personal care products for kids and teens on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Children and teens need gentle products for their skin, and most brands are built for adults or babies.
angle: Teen acne, sensitive skin and hair care need age-appropriate products. Fun packaging and gentle formulas appeal to parents and kids. Paediatric dermatologists and parenting creators are good channels.
